probe.boundary: Exact immutable source in a cached Linux image, root-owned read-only inputs and nonroot check process, isolated loopback/network-none with no host mounts/socket/credentials. Check execution is not independent semantic or whole-system acceptance.

scope: Empty source archive in the registered immutable local image/profile. No application code, cloud client, account or network dependency is used. Null package versions mean distribution metadata unavailable; not proof that importing a module is impossible. Service operations describe the installed botocore model only, not account/API availability.
